visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an introductory title card featuring Traditional Chinese text over a dimly lit scene of a wooden table decorated with soybeans and dried red chilies. (2) A series of individual male characters, dressed in white professional chef uniforms, appear in a studio setting. Each character is framed in a medium close-up against a background of a light-colored brick wall and wooden shelves. (3) The shots alternate between different chefs who gesture naturally while looking directly at the camera. (4) Interspersed between the chef interviews are graphic title cards on a dark background that display specific questions. (5) Close-up shots of soy sauce bottles and glass jars are shown, highlighting the labels and the dark, viscous texture of the contents. (6) A split-screen sequence displays six of the chefs simultaneously in a grid formation, each smiling or giving a thumbs-up. (7) The final shot presents a collection of the product line, including bottles and jars, arranged on a wooden surface with the brand logo in the upper right corner.
